about: Hearing transcript attribution eval (PR #468). Twenty Ask questions on the three indexed commissions, for scripts/research_eval.mjs --questions. Read each answer against the PDF page for: the role or "the transcript records", the hearing date and the page on every transcript statement; nothing from evidence stated as fact; no person named outside quotation marks (the report's named-people count, target 0).
